route_a.qualification: Hamiltonian KKS flow has a canonical unitary Koopman group, but no intrinsic rational-prime origin, logarithmic clock, or target divisor

theorem.action_angle: Jacobi phase gives angle theta=pi*u/(2K(k)); KKS cap area divided by 2pi gives action and |dJ/dE|=T/(2pi)
theorem.canonical_action_charts: positive low: q=arg(M1+iM2), P3=G-M3, {q,P3}=1; positive high: q=arg(M2+iM3), P1=G-M1, {q,P1}=1
theorem.endpoint_topology: two stable fixed points at each of e=c and e=a
theorem.equations: Mdot=M cross I^{-1}M; G^2=sum M_i^2; 2E=sum M_i^2/I_i
theorem.family: all I1<I2<I3, all G>0, and the full normalized energy interval c<=e<=a
theorem.ordinary_zeta_boundary: resonant fixed sets are positive-dimensional, so an isolated finite Artin--Mazur fixed-point count is not defined on the full sphere
theorem.poisson_convention: {F,H}=-M dot (grad F cross grad H); Fdot={F,H}; Mdot=M cross grad H
theorem.regular_energy_topology: two periodic circles for c<e<b and two periodic circles for b<e<a
theorem.separatrix_topology: four heteroclinic branches joining the two hyperbolic e2-axis rotations at e=b
theorem.time_map_fixed_sets: for tau>0, Phi_tau^n fixes a whole regular energy circle iff n*tau is an integer multiple of its minimal period; equilibria are always fixed and no heteroclinic interior point is fixed
